name: Upgrade draft (pick 1 of 3)
oneLiner: The roguelite level-up choice: at a moment the game chooses (level-up, chest, wave clear) the world pauses and three upgrade cards deal in with a fan, flip face up and glow by rarity (common, rare, epic); the player moves between them and takes one, cards that share a tag with the build show a synergy hint, a reroll and a skip are optional, and the picked card flies into an owned-upgrades strip. Upgrades are a plain table the designer edits (name, rarity, tags with drawn icons, text with {value}, max stacks, a stat delta or a small apply function); hands are seeded by the module, weighted by rarity, never repeat a card and never offer a maxed upgrade. Picks reach the game only through its own applyDelta / apply / onPick, synchronously inside update(). Smooth HD cards or crisp pixel cards (readable at 256x224).
fits: roguelite and survivor-like action games (level-up every few kills)
action RPG and top-down adventure (chest or shrine boons, level-ups)
deck-builders and run-based RPGs (card or relic rewards after a fight)
tower defence and wave shooters (a boon between waves)
turn-based RPG (a perk choice after each won battle)
any game where a run grows by choosing from a few random upgrades
notFor: fixed stat growth with no choice (G-02 level-up-growth)
buying items for gold (G-01 shop and inventory)
skill trees where every node is visible and permanent
competitive multiplayer where the draw must be computed on a server

needs: the one place in update logic where the moment happens (level-up, chest opened, wave cleared): open() there; a fixed bonus it used to give goes
the stat fields the game really reads, written by applyDelta(stat, amount) (and read by getStat for the card preview and read-back)
key-down events (or polled left / right / confirm / reroll / skip edges) routed to the draft while busy()
a fixed 60 Hz update step (the draft's only clock), also while the world is paused for it
the play field size in native px and ui rects to keep clear (HUD bars)
optional: the game's autoplay flag; the game's save to store serialize(); a fallback upgrade for a maxed build
provides: a seeded, rarity-weighted, duplicate-free draw from a designer-edited upgrade table, with max stacks and requirements
picks delivered only through the game's applyDelta, the table's own apply(target) and onPick(upgrade, info), synchronously inside update()
busy flag: pause the world and route input here while the draft is open
the owned build (owned(), stacks(id), tagCount(tag)) and serialize() / restore() for saves
the overlay rectangle on screen, for other overlays to avoid

params.label: When the draft opens (required; the designer's words)
params.default: at every level-up, instead of the fixed stat bonus

params.label: Autoplay pick (skip = keep the original ?auto=1 ending)

assets: module/upgrade-draft.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_UpgradeDraft): table normalisation, seeded rarity-weighted draw without duplicates or maxed entries (also as the pure GameDNA_UpgradeDraft.deal), card deal / flip / hover / pick / fly animation on its own clock, HD vector cards and crisp pixel cards (6x8 bitmap font, thresholded 1-bit icons), 15 tag icons drawn in code, synergy hints, reroll and skip, owned strip, autoplay, queueing, serialize / restore
no image or audio files (sound cues are a callback; the upgrade table is plain data in the game)

module.skin: optional: skins/skin-api.js + a skin before it (dim colour from ink; a smooth skin's UI font family in HD)
